text:
maria: Quick sync from usability session 1: a few accessibility/copy quirks on the API keys create/rotate/revoke flows. Dropped mock images in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/key-management. Can people scan?
ashish: skimmed. Two immediate asks: make the revoke confirmation explicit about runtime impact, and make the rotate header neutral. Current revoke checkbox text 'I accept' is too hand-wavey. How about 'I understand this key will stop working immediately for all services'?
sam: yes to clearer revoke copy. Also keyboard flow for the reveal action is inconsistent: reveal is a small eye icon button after the masked key. When I tab, it goes to the copy button first, then to the key input, then to the eye icon. We should enforce a logical order: key field -> reveal -> copy -> close.
tayla: agree. plus screen reader behavior: the masked input isn't announced as a readonly text field. Add aria-readonly and role=textbox so VO says 'API key, hidden, read only'. And the reveal should toggle an aria-pressed on the icon.
maria: nice. product question: on rotate we auto-generate and show the new key once, with a 7-second visible window. Some users in the test missed it. Maybe surface a small persistent hint like 'You can view the key only once. Copy it now or view it later in Settings > Key history.' But that conflicts with security. Thoughts?
ashish: don't add a permanent view option. But show a clear ephemeral banner that persists while the key is visible: 'New key visible for 7s. Press Esc to hide. Copy now.' Keyboard and screen reader friendly.
sam: for keyboard users, add an accessible countdown text that updates via aria-live polite: 'Key visible for 6 seconds' etc. Avoid flashing numerics; update every 2s maybe.
tayla: contrast issue: warning banner uses pale amber and grey text. Fails 4.5:1. Options: darken text color or use bold text at 16px. Also ensure icons have accessible name.
maria: permission bits: in the create flow we show role scoping with a multi-select. Some testers didn't realize keys can be scoped per project. Can we add inline helper text: 'Scoped keys limit access to selected projects and actions' and a tiny example link 'When to use scoped keys' that opens KB.
ashish: will add revised copy in Figma. Also will change rotate modal header from 'Rotate key Danger' to simply 'Rotate key' and put consequences in a short paragraph below.
sam: copy button: replace icon-only button with icon+label for small screens. For screen readers, ensure the button has aria-label='Copy API key' and after copy we trigger an aria-live region: 'Key copied to clipboard'.
tayla: focus management: trap focus inside the modal, set initial focus to the first actionable control (reveal), and on close return focus to the original rotate button. Add unit-test steps for this in the PR.
design-bot: Created branch `ui/keyflows-reveal-a11y` -> PR #611 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/611). Automated lint + axe reports attached.
maria: awesome. two more micro-nits: 1) snackbar after rotate says 'Key rotated' but no path to view the key. Make snackbar 'Key rotated  View new key' but the view link should open the drawer only for the actor. 2) Empty state of key list is terse. Use a clear CTA 'Create API key' plus a one-liner about scoping and a link to examples.
sam: also suggest adding an inline example for least privilege: 'Example: runtime tokens -> embed-only; admin tokens -> infra tasks'. Tiny callout.
tayla: I'll draft the accessibility checklist for the PR: focus trap test, reveal keyboard handling (Esc), aria-live for countdown and copy success, contrast check for banners, and screen reader text for masked/revealed states.
ashish: I'll push Figma tweaks and update the PR with the copy + component states. Will ping @tayla for review.
maria: thanks all. follow up in PR thread. :raised_hands:
